needs.text: Whether National Insurance Co. Ltd. sublet, assigned, or otherwise parted with possession of all or part of the tenanted premises to M.L. Sharma, Roop Sharma, Rajiv Nanda/Handa, or another person.
Whether any relevant subletting, assignment, or parting with possession occurred without the landlord's consent in writing.
When M.L. Sharma first obtained occupation and whether the legally relevant possession or transfer occurred on or after 9 June 1952 and continued after his retirement.

What legal mechanism transferred or vested the original New Zealand Insurance Co. Ltd. tenancy or undertaking in National Insurance Co. Ltd., and whether that corporate succession could constitute an assignment or other relevant transfer under the supplied law.
Whether the record contains facts concerning lawful subletting, statutory notice of a sub-tenancy, or protected direct-tenancy status under the supplied Delhi Rent Control Act sections 16 to 18.
How the conflicting accounts concerning M.L. Sharma's employment, employer-provided accommodation, exclusive possession, and post-retirement occupation bear on the alleged parting with possession.
